artboards.title: 4 · Step 3 — all twelve slips, one shot
Desktop · Tank Recon with the chosen top stepper

annotations.text:
THE FLOW, PHONE FIRST — the manager doing this is standing at the console, not at a desk.

Landing → photograph the ATG → check what was read → (if it failed, four ways on) → shoot all twelve slips → (if some didn't read, three choices each) → variance.

Nothing in this flow can dead-end. Every failure screen offers a way forward, and each records WHERE the figure came from — photo, typed, or dip.
This is the 25-Aug glare, designed for. Nothing is saved on a failed read, and "read it off the screen and type it" is offered plainly — a man's eyes beat a camera on a glared LCD.
Partial is normal, not an error. Nine good slips still reconcile — marked provisional, and it firms up on its own when the last three arrive.
TOP STEPPER CHOSEN (owner, 27-Aug) — the right-hand rail is gone. It broke on a phone, and the phone is where this work actually happens.
